title: Coefficient confidence parameter
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let $ ailure	ext{-parameter}$ be a rational number in $(0,1/2]$. Form the family of subsets of the coordinates outside $P$ having size at most $ rac{3k}{4}$, with the cutoff rounded down, and let $N$ be its cardinality. The coefficient confidence parameter is the failure parameter divided by $4N$.
